//: Budgets catch a suite getting materially slower, not slow runners. Each is ~2x the observed median so a real regression trips it while normal runner variance does not. Derived 2026-09-14 from job durations across 15 successful CI runs.

backend-unit-tests.description: Backend unit tests (backup suites run in backend-pbt shard 1). Observed 2026-09-14 across 15 successful runs: min 72s, median 81s, max 99s. The previous 90s budget sat BELOW the observed successful range; one run took 166s on a slow runner with all 2215 tests passing.

backend-pbt-shard.description: Backend PBT shard (FAST_CHECK_NUM_RUNS=15). Shard 1 also runs the serial backup suites and dominates: observed 2026-09-14 min 64s, median 75s, max 122s, plus a 200s failure on a slow runner with all 404 tests passing. Shards 2/3 median 38s/46s. Raised 150s -> 210s.

frontend-tests.description: Frontend Vitest suite (parallel forks). Observed 2026-09-14: min 288s, median 327s, max 335s. The previous 360s budget left only 7% headroom over the observed max.
